name: Hemo Organic Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Hemo Organic Ltd is in the business of trading & distribution of Rice and Textiles.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
HOL is engaged in agro trading across domestic and international markets. Its activities include buying, selling, reselling, importing, exporting, transporting, storing, developing, promoting, marketing, and supplying goods. The company operates at both retail and wholesale levels.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has high debtors of 382 days.
